news.headline: Trump loses second Supreme Court bid over E Jean Carroll sex abuse case
news.summary: E Jean Carroll secures another legal victory as US Supreme Court refuses Donald Trump’s appeal over 1996 abuse claims.

news.headline: Anti-migrants protesters gather outside SADC Summit
news.summary: Protesters in South Africa gather outside of a meeting of regional leaders demanding that they fetch their people. Frustration continues to fester on all sides as Pretoria tries to repair fractured relationships with its neighbours whilst placating the powerful anti-migrant movement.

news.headline: Torrential rains flood homes and roads across Lima, Peru
news.summary: Heavy rains have flooded oads in Lima, while river overflows, landslides, and road closures continue to affect Peru.

news.headline: Trump’s approval rating sinks to new low at 33 percent
news.summary: New poll found a majority of US citizens concerned about the US war on Iran.

news.headline: How Ukraine’s Satellites Help Drive Its War Drones
news.summary: Ukrainian drone teams have a powerful new tool: near real-time information on troop movements and locations.
